tab.label: Plugins
tab.title: Plugin settings
tab.intro: What the price and exchange-rate sources ask for. Personal settings are yours alone; instance settings apply to everyone, and only an administrator changes them.
tab.empty: No installed plugin asks for settings.

pluginSettings.loadError: The plugin settings could not be loaded.

secret.unreadable: Saved, but this instance's key cannot read it. If an administrator can put the old key back, that comes first; otherwise enter it again.
secret.willClear: It will be deleted when you save.
secret.writeOnly: Once saved, it is never shown again.

field.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change it.
field.invalidEnv: The server variable that sets it is invalid: the plugin stays unconfigured until it is fixed.
field.invalidEnvBy: The server variable {variable} is invalid: the plugin stays unconfigured until it is fixed.
field.invalidStored: The saved value is no longer valid: the default applies.
field.willUseDefault: The saved value will be deleted when you save: the default applies.

refusals.UNKNOWN_FIELD: This setting no longer exists: reload the page.
refusals.FORBIDDEN_SCOPE: Only an administrator can change this setting.
refusals.LOCKED_BY_ENV: A server variable sets it: it cannot be changed here.
refusals.INVALID_VALUE: The value is not valid for this setting.

form.refused: Nothing was saved: check the settings below.
form.conflict: These settings changed meanwhile: they have been reloaded, save again.
form.keyUnavailable: Secrets cannot be saved: this instance's key cannot be used (see the configuration checks).
form.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.

coingecko.name: CoinGecko
coingecko.about: The CoinGecko account the CoinGecko plugins share: its API key and its plan.

description.api_key: The key of a CoinGecko account. A free Demo key is enough.
description.plan: The plan of the key: a Demo key answers on the public API, a paid key on the Pro API.

coingecko.callsNote: CoinGecko's month may start again on another day: this is LibreFolio's count.

group.countsOn: Its calls count on {group}: the counter and the limits are there.

notConfigured.invalidLimitAdmin: The environment variable {variable} has an invalid value (it needs an integer ≥ 0, or nothing): it must be fixed on the server. Until it is fixed, {provider} is stopped.
notConfigured.invalidMember: {provider} is stopped: one of its settings on the server is invalid. Tell the administrator.
notConfigured.managed: {provider} is not available on this instance: its configuration is managed by the service provider. Contact support.
notConfigured.missingAdmin: {provider} needs configuring: {count, plural, one {this setting is missing} other {these settings are missing}}: {fields}.

notConfigured.missingAdminGeneric: {provider} needs configuring: a required setting is missing.
notConfigured.missingMemberGeneric: {provider} needs configuring: ask an administrator to set its required settings.
notConfigured.missingAdminPhrase: {provider} needs configuring: {fields} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} missing.
notConfigured.missingMemberPhrase: {provider} needs configuring: ask an administrator to set {fields}.

calls.title: Calls
calls.utcNote: Calendar windows in UTC: the day starts again at 00:00 UTC, the week on Monday, the month on the 1st. Counts read when the page loads.

full.minute: Per-minute limit reached: {count} of {limit}. Resumes at {time} UTC.
full.hour: Hourly limit reached: {count} of {limit}. Resumes at {time} UTC.
full.day: Daily limit reached: {count} of {limit}. Resumes on {date} at {time} UTC.
full.week: Weekly limit reached: {count} of {limit}. Resumes on {date} at {time} UTC.
full.month: Monthly limit reached: {count} of {limit}. Resumes on {date} at {time} UTC.

stopped.minute: Stopped: the per-minute limit is 0, no call goes out until an administrator changes it.
stopped.hour: Stopped: the hourly limit is 0, no call goes out until an administrator changes it.
stopped.day: Stopped: the daily limit is 0, no call goes out until an administrator changes it.
stopped.week: Stopped: the weekly limit is 0, no call goes out until an administrator changes it.
stopped.month: Stopped: the monthly limit is 0, no call goes out until an administrator changes it.

calls.managedFull: Instance limit reached: resumes on {date} at {time} UTC.
calls.managedFullAt: Instance limit reached: resumes at {time} UTC.
calls.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change the limits.

minute.label: Minute limit
minute.description: The most calls this instance makes to the service in one minute (UTC). Empty: no limit; 0: stopped.

hour.label: Hourly limit
hour.description: The most calls this instance makes to the service in one hour (UTC). Empty: no limit; 0: stopped.

day.label: Daily limit
day.description: The most calls this instance makes to the service in one day (UTC, calendar). Empty: no limit; 0: stopped.

week.label: Weekly limit
week.description: The most calls this instance makes to the service in one week (UTC, from Monday). Empty: no limit; 0: stopped.

month.label: Monthly limit
month.description: The most calls this instance makes to the service in one month (UTC, from the 1st). Empty: no limit; 0: stopped.
